_comment: ASSEMBLIES ONLY, NOT INGOTS, and that is the scoping decision worth recording. An alloy ingot is
a MIXTURE - you remelt it, you do not prise it apart with a knife - so conductive, energetic,
dark steel and the rest are deliberately absent from this set. What is here is the things a
player manufactures, supersedes, and ends up with a chest of.
THE MARGIN. An iron gear costs four iron ingots, four iron nuggets and one Grain of Infinity.
This returns scrap metal and a grain at 25 percent. Scrap metal is not iron - it blasts into
a COPPER nugget - so there is no route back to the ingots at all, and the grain loses four to
TEMPORARY, and guarded. Pack content living in the engine because the pack cannot ship data on
26.1.2; it leaves with the rest - see docs/handoff_cross_mod_teardown.md.
